title: Chapter 30
text:
The bullets that came from the front hit the mechanical arm, and its durability dropped rapidly. A stray bullet hit Han Xiao's shoulder and took away 16 HP. Han Xiao felt a slight pain, but he did not care. His endurance was very high, and his muscles were very tough. The bullet was stuck in his flesh and could not penetrate. A stream of blood stained his clothes.

The mechanical arm hammered a minion's chest, and with a 'dong' sound, his chest caved in, and he could not be more dead. Han Xiao grabbed another minion and used him as a meat shield. At this time, the four minions behind Raccoon finally stood up and opened fire. All the bullets hit the meat shield, and the minion was instantly turned into a sieve.

Han Xiao's back muscles moved, and a huge force burst out, breaking the bolt lock. With a crack, the door flew out, and the screws fell to the ground like jumping metal fairies. Han Xiao turned around and ran out.

"Chase!"

Raccoon roared. Footsteps could be heard everywhere in the junkyard. The dozens of minions patrolling nearby heard the gunshots and rushed over.

The Kro Junkyard was the Raccoon's base camp. There were enemies everywhere, and it was difficult for Han Xiao to move forward. Han Xiao met a group of minions who came to support him, and at the price of losing another twenty points of durability of his mechanical arm, he swiftly killed the enemy and snatched the pistol.

With a long-range attack, Han Xiao immediately got rid of the disadvantage of close combat. With his right hand holding the pistol ready to fire, and his left hand holding the pistol to help him aim, he moved forward in a crouch. It was a standard tactical movement that allowed him to react quickly.

[Basic Shooting] and [Precision Shooting] improved the accuracy of the gun, and it would not trigger more than two shots to kill the enemy. Han Xiao's reaction was very fast, and he always made the first move before the minions. A shot to the body to interrupt the enemy's attack, and then he immediately raised the gun slightly and shot the enemy's head. The interval was not more than 0.5 seconds. If there were many people surrounding him, Han Xiao would roll and dodge smoothly, and he would frequently counterattack and kill the enemy. The only thing that limited Han Xiao was bullets. Every time he killed a wave of enemies, he would search the corpses to replenish his ammo. Every time he killed a wave of enemies, he would leave behind a trail of corpses and blood.

Raccoon was shocked. A single person had easily killed more than 20 of his minions!

However, there were simply too many minions. They swarmed in from all directions and gradually surrounded him. The suppressive fire made it difficult for him to emerge.

Han Xiao hid behind the shell of an abandoned car. Dozens of muzzles flashed in the dark, and the dense sound of bullets hitting the bunker made him unable to hear his own breathing. He could only occasionally counterattack.

"Fortunately, this is my territory. No matter how good he is at fighting, he is only one person. Sooner or later, he will be caught."

Raccoon hardened his heart. Once he caught Han Xiao, he would make Han Xiao regret being born into this world.

Just as he was thinking this, something unexpected happened.

Rapid gunshots from submachine guns rang out like a violent storm. With a sweeping murderous aura, they cut in from the side of the battlefield and killed a large number of minions as if they were harvesting wheat. Screams of agony rang out one after another.

The Bee Sting Squad charged into the battlefield under the cover of the night, each of them armed with a submachine gun. They ran and dodged, advancing and retreating in an orderly manner. Their nimble movements showed their wealth of experience on the battlefield. Raccoon's men couldn't even organize a decent counterattack before they were sent scattering.

"Where did these mercenaries come from?!"

Raccoon was shocked. He thought these mercenaries were here to kill him. Maybe they were coveting his territory, or maybe it was revenge …

Just as he was letting his imagination run wild, what happened next stunned him. The menacing mercenaries suddenly turned around and charged at Han Xiao on the other side. They didn't even look at him.

These merciless mercenaries were actually targeting Han Xiao?!

Raccoon's eyes widened.

As someone who lived in the gray area, he understood one principle. One could tell a person's level from the enemies they made. These mercenaries didn't hesitate to take the risk in the West Capital. The reward from their backer must be equivalent to the risk they took. From this, he could tell that Han Xiao was definitely not a simple person!

Raccoon recalled what Han Xiao had said.

"You can try turning on your computer and entering the dark web to look for the latest bounty."

Could it be that Han Xiao was telling the truth?

What was his background?!

…

"It's the sound of submachine guns."

Han Xiao's ears twitched. The mission target had finally appeared. Using the light from the muzzle, he determined the location of the Bee Sting Squad.

"Three hundred meters to the west. Six people, six submachine guns." Han Xiao quickly calculated. The enemy's firepower was ferocious. He would definitely be at a disadvantage if he fought them head-on.

"Luckily, I prepared ahead of time and brought along the Ranger." Han Xiao secretly rejoiced. He took out a remote control with a screen from his pocket. This was the Ranger's remote control device that he had made himself. The chip of the Ranger was a common product that he had bought from the market. It was easy to operate. He only needed to enter a simple program to create the remote control device.

After turning on the power source, a series of buzzing noises rang out for two seconds. The robot's eyes were connected to the remote control device. Everything it saw would be displayed on the screen. At this time, the screen was marked with a "Out of Control Range". The battle just now had caused Han Xiao to exceed the control range of fifty meters.

Han Xiao stood up decisively and ran back the way he had come in the night. The Bee Sting Squad's submachine guns swept toward him immediately.

He moved swiftly. Using the obstacles and large pieces of trash in the junkyard as cover, he weaved through the rain of bullets.

"Damn it, there's too much cover here!" The long-haired guy from the Bee Sting Squad cursed. He skillfully reloaded his gun. "He runs faster than a rabbit."

Originally, the Bee Sting Squad had planned to assassinate Han Xiao. However, Han Xiao had already started fighting with Raccoon. On second thought, they might be able to use the scene of a gang fight as cover for their purpose. Thus, they moved out without hesitation.

"He's already running away. Hurry up and finish him off!"

Kelly shouted.

After the earlier massacre, Raccoon's men had lost their morale. They covered their heads and fled like rats. No one dared to interfere with their mission. Seeing Han Xiao running away, the Bee Sting Squad became even more fearless and became more aggressive.

Han Xiao, who was in the midst of running, suddenly pulled back his head. A strand of hair was cut off by a stray bullet. It fluttered in the wind as he ran. He slid past two car shells and hid behind cover.

The rest stop was not far away. The remote control in his hand finally showed that he had entered the control range. The screen was connected.

"Activate!"

In the messy rest stop, the dust-proof cloth on the trolley suddenly shook. Two flashes of red light appeared!

It was Ranger's eyes!

The engine hummed to life, and the tracks started moving. Han Xiao controlled Ranger One and drove out of the rest stop.

At this time, the Bee Sting Squad was not far away from him. Ranger One's armor might not be able to withstand the concentrated fire of six submachine guns. It was too risky to face them head-on. His advantage was the element of surprise. No one would guess that he had robot backup. A surprise attack was the best choice.

Han Xiao looked around. His eyes lit up. He had found a suitable place to set up an ambush.

Not far away, there was an intersection between two car shells. It was a blind spot, and it was right in the path of the Bee Sting Squad. Han Xiao controlled Ranger One to hide in the intersection. He held his breath and waited for the best opportunity.

The environment of the junkyard was very noisy, and the sound of gunfire was endless. The sound of the first generation ranger's engine was covered by the noise and almost did not attract any attention. Only Kelly felt that something was wrong. This was the intuition that he had developed after walking between life and death many times. He stopped and said, "I have a bad feeling."

"What did you find?" the long-haired man asked.

"That's the problem. I didn't find anything."

"There won't be any accidents. The target has been forced into a dead end. He's dead for sure."

The long-haired man raised the flag angrily. The moment he finished speaking, the Bee Sting Squad stepped into Ranger One's shooting range.

At the same time, Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He lightly pressed the button to fire.

Tut tut tut tut tut —

Ranger One's fingers spewed out thick flames and smoke. A rain of steel poured out!

The approaching shadow of death froze the expressions of all the Bee Sting Squad members.
